runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: The 0.2.0-alpha.1 Codex plugin archive was extracted, registered with codex plugin marketplace add, installed twice with codex plugin add, listed, removed, and deregistered under an isolated temporary CODEX_HOME.
runtime.permissionProfile: Writes restricted to a disposable marketplace extraction and isolated temporary CODEX_HOME; the user marketplace and plugin cache were not used.

assertions.evidence: Codex accepted the extracted marketplace root as oh-my-stack and listed its exact .agents/plugins/marketplace.json coordinate.
Codex listed oh-my-stack@oh-my-stack as available, installed version 0.2.0-alpha.1, and reported its isolated cache root.
A recursive comparison between packages/codex and the Codex cache root returned no difference.
A second codex plugin add completed successfully at the same version and cache coordinate.
Codex removed the plugin, listed it as not installed, removed the marketplace, and then reported no marketplaces in scope.
The installed tree retained the portable root plugin.json and .codex-plugin/plugin.json compatibility manifest, both at version 0.2.0-alpha.1.

limitations: The local marketplace is intentionally dormant until the user registers and installs it; release building and extraction do not change Codex configuration.
codex plugin marketplace upgrade is only available for Git marketplaces on this runtime. Local bundle refresh uses codex plugin add after replacing or re-extracting the marketplace tree.
Skill discovery and invocation are covered separately by the related complete public-Skill matrix and prove-it-works evidence.
